# The Lion Company

> The Lion Company (legal name Company of Lions) is a 501(c)(3) Christian nonprofit ministry founded by Jonathan Gibson. It exists to bring unity among Christians of every background and experience level around the world through love, relationship, discipleship and education, with Jesus Himself as the common vision. Motto: "Bold as a lion" (Proverbs 28:1).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.thelioncompany.org/): the ministry, its vision, prayer requests, the podcast, giving, the store, the mailing list and contact.
- [Media library](https://www.thelioncompany.org/media): podcast episodes and Bible teachings on video.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.thelioncompany.org/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.thelioncompany.org/terms)

## The Lion Company Podcast

Hosted by Jonathan Gibson. Honest conversations on faith, discipleship, marriage, family and church reform.

- [Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-lion-company-podcast/id1783214612)
